title: RDMA Connection Manager (RDMA CM) message
summary: RDMA CM (Connection Manager) provides connection establishment for RDMA (InfiniBand, RoCE, iWARP). Messages are exchanged over a well-known port (7200 for IW_CM, 7201 for RDMA_CM). The RDMA CM message header: service ID (8 bytes), DREQ/DREP/DREQ (request/reply), SIDR (service ID resolution) request/reply, and MRA (multipath RNR).

structure.meaning: Service ID (well-known port mapped to 64-bit ID).
Request to resolve a service ID to a QP.
Reply with QP number and status.

notes: RDMA CM uses the RDMA CM kernel module (rdma_cm) for connection management.
RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) allows direct memory access between machines without CPU involvement.
RDMA transports: InfiniBand, RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet), iWARP (RDMA over TCP).
RDMA is used by high-performance computing, storage (NVMe-oF), and databases.
